WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne purchased the Kiwanis Park land in 2020 with sixth-
penny Optional Sales and Use Tax for the development ofa new regional park in eastern Cheyenne
located in the southwest corner of East Pershing Boulevard and Whitney Road: and
WHEREAS, the Cityof Cheyennehas developed a Master Plan for the K iwan is Park; and
industrial and commercial employment centers; and
extended into the Kiwanis Park and is being extended into the Cheyenne LEADS Business Park
south of the K iwan is Park; and
WHEREAS, the Laramie County Conservation District (LCCD) has move to and opened
their headquarters in the Cheyenne LEADS Business Park southeast of the Kiwanis Park and
UP RR Mainline trackswhere Dry Creekflows through; and
WHEREAS, the Dry Creek Drainage goes through the Kiwanis Park and crosses under
the Union Pacific Mainline Railroad track and then flows into the Cheyenne LEADS Business
Park; and
WHEREAS, the Dry Creek Drainage has a history of flooding against the embankment of
the UPRR Mainline track as it did during thehistoric 1985 Cheyenne Flood; and
WHEREAS, the Cheyenne Metropolitan Planning Organization(MPO)retained Summit
Engineering September 28,2020 to develop the Kiwanis (East) Park Greenway Underpass And
Drainage Plan; and
WHEREAS, the Kiwanis (East)Park Green way Underpass And Drainage Plan explored
the potential for reducing thebuildup of stormwater along the north sideof the Union Pacific
Railroad Embankment and improve flood mitigation for surrounding properties; and
WHEREAS, the Kiwanis(East)Park Green way Underpass And Drainage Plan identified
a route for the Greater Cheyenne Greenway through K iwan is Park and across the Union Pacific
Railroad (UPRR) to join with the planned LEADS Trail along Campstool Road; and

WHEREAS, the Kiwanis(East)Park Greenway Underpass And Drainage Plan has
developed a creative concept to redirect the drainage of Dry Creek under the UPRR Mainline
track so that the existing drainage structure can be repurposed into a Greenway and pedestrian
tunnel connecting the Kiwanis Park with the LCCD property in the Cheyenne LEADS Business
Park; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne has obtained Federal Emergency Management
Administration (FEMA) funds for the design of the Dry Creek Drainage improvements; and
WHEREAS, the Cheyenne M PO Technical and Citizens'Advisory Committees reviewed
the Kiwanis(East)Park Green way Underpass And Drainage Plan and recommended adoptionby
theM PO Policy Committee; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne Planning Commission held a public hearing on October
17, 2022 and accepted public comments.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF
THE CITY OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING:
THAT, the City of Cheyenne Planning Commission hereby adopts the “Kiwanis (East)
Park Green way Underpass and Drainage Plan"dated September 2022 and recommends that the
City of Cheyenne Governing Body certify the“Kiwanis (East) Park Greenway Underpass and
Drainage Plan."
THAT, the“Kiwanis (East)Park Greenway Underpass and Drainage Plan"amends the
Greenway element of Connect 2045, the Cheyenne Area Master Transportation Plan for the
Kiwanis (East) Park area.
THAT, this resolution shall become effective after its passage and approval.
FURTHERMORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the “Kiwanis (East) Park Greenway
Underpass and Drainage Plan"will be used as guidance for the future design and reconstruction
of the drainage work and Greenway.
